_note: AOR's per-page XML carries NO book-level bibliography -- only the directory name, which is the project's own short label. These are filled ONLY where the label is unambiguous (a classical or Renaissance author whose name IS the label). Unresolved entries are null on purpose: guessing an author here would put a fabricated citation into an influence graph, which is the one thing this corpus exists to avoid. To resolve them, read the book records on archaeologyofreading.org itself (each has a full bibliographic header) -- open task, docs/SOURCES.md.
